legs.label: Donchian breakout
legs.rules: Buy a close above the 55-bar high (sell a close below the 55-bar low); exit on a close beyond the 10-bar opposite channel; stop 3× ATR.

legs.label: Donchian breakout
legs.rules: Buy a close above the 55-bar high (sell a close below the 55-bar low); exit on a close beyond the 20-bar opposite channel; stop 3× ATR.

legs.label: Asia range breakout
legs.rules: Mark the Asia range (8 PM – midnight NY). From 2 AM to 11 AM NY, buy the first close above it or sell the first close below it; stop at the middle of the range; target 2× the range; close by 4 PM NY.

legs.label: Trend pullback (RSI)
legs.rules: When price is above EMA50, buy when RSI(2) drops below 10 (mirror for shorts below the EMA); exit when RSI(2) rises above 70 or after 48 bars; stop 3× ATR.

legs.label: Trend pullback (RSI)

legs.label: EMA crossover trend
legs.rules: Buy when EMA10 crosses above EMA50 (sell on the opposite cross); stop 2× ATR, trailed at 2× ATR from the best close; exit on the opposite cross.
